question: In relation to the liver transplant, indicate the following CORRECT:

options.opa: The most frequent indication for liver transplantation today is cirrhosis due to B virus infection (HBV).
options.opb: Liver metastases from colon cancer are an approved indication for liver transplantation.
options.opc: The MELD system is a prognostic model that allows the prioritization for liver transplantation of patients on the list.
options.opd: Liver transplantation would be the best treatment option for a 45-year-old patient with diffuse hepatocarcinoma.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Liver transplantation -> treatment option for end-stage liver disease -> cirrhosis due to HBV (HBV) is a common cause -> opa is correct -> 80%
CHAIN: Liver transplantation -> approved for certain cases of liver metastases -> liver metastases from colon cancer can be an indication -> opb is correct -> 75%
CHAIN: MELD system -> assesses the severity of liver disease -> used to prioritize patients on the transplant list -> opc is correct -> 90%
CHAIN: Diffuse hepatocarcinoma -> aggressive form of liver cancer -> liver transplantation can be considered as a treatment option -> opd is plausible -> 70%
analysis: Liver transplantation is not typically indicated for diffuse hepatocarcinoma as it is considered a contraindication due to the high risk of recurrence. The MELD system is indeed used for prioritizing patients on the liver transplant list. Liver metastases from colon cancer are generally not considered an approved indication for liver transplantation.
